marketLayer.title: HK Tech & AI Infrastructure CapEx
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech giants significantly increased capital expenditure on AI infrastructure and proprietary cloud architectures, driven by surging enterprise demand for generative AI models.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerated CapEx may compress near-term operating margins, but positions the platform companies for higher-margin SaaS monetization over a multi-year horizon.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Supply chain bottlenecks for high-performance computing hardware and potential expansion of export control lists.

marketLayer.title: US Macro Liquidity & Fed Policy Expectations
marketLayer.fact: Cooling US core PCE price index data and moderating wage growth led market futures to price in higher probability of Fed rate cuts in the second half of the year.
marketLayer.inference: Dovish rate expectations provide valuation relief for rate-sensitive US mega-cap tech equities and improve liquidity flows into Hong Kong growth sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sticky shelter inflation components and potential upside volatility in energy commodities disrupting the disinflationary path.

marketLayer.title: Chinese EV Exporters & Overseas Expansion
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed electric vehicle manufacturers reported record export growth to Southeast Asian and Latin American markets, partially offsetting domestic price competition.
marketLayer.inference: Global market diversification is becoming a critical driver for margin defense, favoring automakers with established overseas logistics and localized supply chains.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving regulatory hurdles, anti-subsidy tariff reviews, and foreign exchange risks in emerging markets.
